author: alipollesauthor
title: Looking for artist for character art and book covers
content: 🎨 LOOKING FOR AN ARTIST! 📚✨ I’m looking to connect with an artist/illustrator that I can work with for future book projects! I’d love to find someone who creates: ✨ Character art 📖 Book cover designs 🖤 Fantasy, romantasy, paranormal & contemporary romance artwork 🎨 Other book-related illustrations and promotional art I am specifically looking for an artist who creates their work WITHOUT the use of AI-generated artwork. I want to support human artists and build a relationship with someone I can hopefully work with on multiple projects in the future. I’m a published indie author with several books already out and plenty more planned, so I’d love to find someone who is open to ongoing paid commissions. 💕 If you’re an artist—or know someone you think would be a great fit—please tag them below or send me their portfolio/page! Feel free to share this post to help me find the right person! 🖤📚 — Ali Polles, Author Contact: Tag or send portfolio, or DM

title: Seeking book designers and illustrators for collaborations
content: FOR BOOK DESIGNERS & ILLUSTRATORS 🗣️ Malaka Books bakal menerbitkan beberapa buku baru.
